name: ai-discovery-site-audit
description: Primary product: AI Discovery Site Audit — AEO/GEO Fix Pack for 5 USDC. Seven auxiliary Base-USDC resources remain available after the primary item.

items.serviceName: AI Discovery Site Audit — AEO/GEO Fix Pack
items.description: AI Discovery Site Audit — AEO/GEO Fix Pack. Audit one credential-free public HTTPS page with a public IPv4 DNS answer: 22 deterministic technical SEO, security-header, and accessibility-surface checks; bounded robots.txt, llms.txt, and sitemap.xml observations; seven AI-discovery findings; five evidence-derived remediation slots; and SHA-256 integrity. Immediate JSON; no JavaScript, login, exploit tests, or ranking promise. Sample and methodology: https://agent402.dev/site-release-audit.
Rank and schedule up to 50 tasks with dependencies into at most 24 blocks. Local deterministic algorithm; no LLM, network, storage, or randomness.

items.serviceName: x402 Endpoint Health Check — v2, Base USDC & Resource Binding
items.description: One-cent bounded health snapshot for a public x402 GET endpoint: challenge, resource binding, Base USDC, and Bazaar facts without paying the target.
Website security-header preflight with seven bounded HEAD-only checks.

items.serviceName: Verified URL Evidence Snapshot — HTTP, TLS & SHA-256
items.description: Verified URL Evidence Snapshot: bounded credential-free public HTTPS observation pinned to public IPv4, with HTTP headers, authenticated TLS, seven checks, and optional SHA-256 content fingerprint. Defaults: url=https://example.com/ and content_fingerprint=true. Request-target limits: 2300 raw UTF-8 bytes; 2302 bytes as a JSON string.

items.serviceName: x402 Endpoint Launch-Readiness Audit — v2 Base USDC
items.description: x402 endpoint launch-readiness audit for v2, Base USDC, and Bazaar metadata.

items.serviceName: Printable Fantasy Quest-Card Deck + Offline Workshop
items.description: Printable fantasy quest-card deck and offline card workshop.

items.serviceName: Bulk QR Code Generator Pack — CSV/TSV/JSON to SVG/PNG/A4
items.description: Bulk QR code generator pack: CSV, TSV, or JSON to SVG, PNG, and A4.
